**Finding: ASSIGN — compliant (preferred).**

Section 24 gives us the full customer-side bargain:

- **§ 24.1** — we may assign to an Affiliate or to a merger/reorganization/acquisition/substantially-all-assets successor **without Vendor's consent** (prompt notice plus assignee assumption only).
- **§ 24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and may never assign to a direct Customer competitor without our consent.
- **§ 24.3** — all other assignments are mutually consent-based on a not-unreasonably-withheld/conditioned/delayed standard.
- **§ 24.4** — our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service.

Cross-checks: § 9 termination is limited to insolvency/general assignment for creditors (no change-of-control trigger), § 13 expressly permits transfer of our licence rights on a Section 24 assignment, and § 30 contains no residual assignment restriction.

Only note (not a redline): the competitor bar is qualified as "direct ... without Customer's consent" rather than absolute — a minor sub-element gated by our own consent, so no change proposed.
